en.p: Ten empty bags are placed in a row, and there are 8 balls. All the balls are distributed into the bags so that each bag contains at most 2 balls. Find the number of ways that satisfy the following conditions. (The balls are indistinguishable from one another.) [4 points]

box: (A) The number of bags containing exactly 1 ball is 4 or 6.
(B) Every bag adjacent to a bag containing 2 balls contains no balls.
